notes: 修复点 × 有待推送却没推送：端到端诊断确认后端判据与路由完全正常（手动 POST auto-exit 立即 queued:true 并推送），根因是前端卸载信标 pagehide→sendBeacon 在 DSH 真正退出时请求送不到后端。改为不依赖前端：后端 2 分钟定时复查检测到待拉取/推送即预排 watcher 进 wait 态（shouldCloseDsh:false 不关 DSH），用户点 × 关闭后预排的 watcher 自动 run 执行；前端信标保留作双保险。定时复查无人值守不弹确认框，watcher 超时后允许重排，开关每次复查重读。保留 0.4.04 及以前全部修复。
notesEn: Fix '× close with pending push but nothing happens': end-to-end diagnosis confirmed the backend check and route are fine (manual POST auto-exit instantly returns queued:true and pushes); root cause is the frontend unload beacon pagehide→sendBeacon never reaching the backend when DSH actually exits. Now independent of the frontend: the backend 2-min periodic check queues a watcher into wait state as soon as pending pull/push is detected (shouldCloseDsh:false, no auto-close); when the user clicks × to close, the pre-queued watcher auto-runs. Frontend beacon kept as a backup. Periodic check is unattended (no confirm dialog), allows re-queue after watcher timeout, and re-reads switches each cycle. Keeps 0.4.04 and all earlier fixes.
